 * Now we let $\tau_3$ be the 3x3 block-diagonal matrix with blocks $\tau_1$
 * and $\tau_2$, and we check the factorization condition (1.3). That is,
 * we check that $\Xi^{(3)}(\tau_3) = \Xi^{(1)}(\tau_1) \Xi^{(2)}(\tau_2)$.
 * We calculate $\Xi^{(3)}$ via Grushevsky's basis.
 * (Note that our formula (1.5b) is not suitable for block-diagonal
